title: Scaffold-Constrained Subset Dynamic Programming for Exact SSE Clustering
summary: Exact Euclidean \(K\)-means partitions \(n\) observations into \(K\) unlabelled clusters, but the unrestricted search is generally exponential. We use data-derived geometric graphs to precondition an exact subset dynamic program: as a result only connected vertex subsets are admitted as clusters, while sum-of-squared-errors (SSE) loss is unchanged. A remaining-set recurrence minimises fixed-\(K\) or penalised SSE, with exact factorisation over the connected components of each remaining set.
